description: Step 2: send the signed customization. The Worker checks the signature and that the signer owns the companion on chain, then saves it.

companion.description: The companion's token id (a whole number).

look.description: canon, gold, marble, teal or velvet (a frame over her approved still).

name.description: Her name: 2 to 20 letters, digits, spaces, dots or hyphens, no links.

nonce.description: The nonce from the matching *_prepare tool.

owner.description: The holder's 0x wallet (the one that owns her on chain).

signature.description: personal_sign of the exact `message` from the prepare tool, by the holder's wallet.
